descriptors.help: Seconds between background reconcile passes, which refresh session state on every host.
descriptors.label: Reconcile interval

descriptors.help: How long a working session may go without a hook, a turn, transcript growth or pane output before it reads idle.
descriptors.label: Stale working timeout

descriptors.help: How long a session marked stale asks for a look before the tick lifts the mark on its own. An attach or any hook lifts it sooner.
descriptors.label: Stale mark lifts after

descriptors.help: How long a resumable session lost to a host reboot or the tmux server exiting is kept before it is deleted, counted from when it was lost.
descriptors.label: Keep lost sessions

descriptors.help: Sessions resumed in parallel by Restore lost sessions.
descriptors.label: Concurrent restores

descriptors.help: Pause between starting each resumed session in a batch restore.
descriptors.label: Delay between restores

descriptors.help: Press Enter for sessions stuck on a "Press Enter" prompt. Auth menus, trust prompts and reconnects are always notify-only.
descriptors.label: Press Enter when stuck

descriptors.help: Recreate a session that ran out of memory, within the budget below.
descriptors.label: Recreate out-of-memory sessions

descriptors.help: Recreates one session may get per 24 hours. A session that is working, or finished a turn after the flag, is never recreated.
descriptors.label: Out-of-memory budget

danger.message: Idle sessions past the limits below will be stopped or removed without asking.

descriptors.help: Stop or remove sessions that have been idle longer than the limits below.
descriptors.label: Garbage-collect idle sessions

descriptors.help: How long a background agent may sit idle before it is stopped.
descriptors.label: Background agent idle limit

descriptors.help: How long a shell session may sit inactive before it is killed.
descriptors.label: Shell idle limit

descriptors.help: How long a work session may sit idle before it is removed. A dirty worktree goes through safe remove.
descriptors.label: Work session idle limit

descriptors.help: Seconds between garbage-collection sweeps.
descriptors.label: GC sweep interval

descriptors.help: How long a lost session from outside fleet is kept before it is removed. It can never be resumed; this only rides out a restart.
descriptors.label: Keep lost outside sessions

descriptors.help: Per-host folder that holds your repositories. A host with no entry uses $CLAUDE_FLEET_PROJECTS_BASE (local only), then the layout default.
descriptors.label: Projects roots

descriptors.help: Where a repository sits under the projects root: github puts it at root/owner/repo, flat at root/repo.
descriptors.label: Projects layout

descriptors.help: How long an open task (counted from its start, else its creation) may run before the liveness sweep fails it.
descriptors.label: Task timeout

descriptors.help: Re-add deleted worktree directories without anyone opening them. A stale entry is dropped only when its parent folder is the one seen while it was healthy, so an unmounted volume is never touched.
descriptors.label: Re-create vanished worktrees

descriptors.help: Seconds between automatic workspace checks, each repairing at most five worktrees.
descriptors.label: Workspace check interval

descriptors.help: Largest transcript Move to host copies; a bigger one is refused.
descriptors.label: Move: transcript cap

descriptors.help: Largest git bundle of unpushed work Move to host relays; a bigger one is refused.
descriptors.label: Move: git bundle cap

descriptors.help: Largest single git-ignored file or directory Move to host carries; bigger ones are left behind.
descriptors.label: Move: ignored entry cap

descriptors.help: Total git-ignored payload Move to host carries.
descriptors.label: Move: ignored total cap

descriptors.help: Largest per-session Claude directory (subagent transcripts, tool results) Move to host carries; above it the biggest files stay behind.
descriptors.label: Move: session state cap

descriptors.help: How long "Transfer when it finishes" waits for the session to go idle before giving up.
descriptors.label: Move: wait timeout

descriptors.help: Sum each session's token usage from its Claude transcript and show an estimated cost.
descriptors.label: Collect token usage

descriptors.help: Seconds between usage passes, one batched read per host.
descriptors.label: Usage interval

descriptors.help: Per-model prices for the estimated cost, in USD per million tokens (input, output, cache_write, cache_read). {} uses the built-in prices only.
descriptors.label: Price overrides

descriptors.help: Newest error and warning reports kept; older ones are pruned on every insert.
descriptors.label: Error reports kept

descriptors.help: How long an error or warning report is kept before the age sweep deletes it.
descriptors.label: Error report age

descriptors.help: Percent of the context window at which a session needs you. The chip turns red here and amber 15 points below.
descriptors.label: Context red threshold

descriptors.help: How old a host's recorded Claude version may be before the "older than the fleet" badge stops trusting it and shows nothing.
descriptors.label: Trust a host's Claude version for

descriptors.help: Used share of a host's home filesystem at which the host reads as disk low.
descriptors.label: Disk low at

descriptors.help: Patch releases a host's Claude may trail the fleet's newest before the host reads as behind.
descriptors.label: Claude behind after

descriptors.help: How long a reachable host with a live session may send no hook before it reads as hooks silent.
descriptors.label: Hooks silent after

danger.message: Fleet will write its skills into a folder another git repository tracks.

descriptors.help: Write fleet's skills even when a host's ~/.claude/skills is inside a git work tree, such as a dotfiles checkout. Off: provisioning refuses such a host.
descriptors.label: Provision into git-tracked skills

descriptors.help: Provisioning installs fleet's ag launcher (~/.local/share/ag) and, when the host's login shell sees no cl command, a cl shim (claude --yolo) in ~/.local/bin. Off stops the next install; it removes nothing a previous run left — docs/hub.md names the paths to delete by hand.
descriptors.label: Install the ag launcher

descriptors.help: Days a work journal row is kept once its conversation ended and its work is done or unlinked.
descriptors.label: Retention: work journal

descriptors.help: Days a done ticket that no session links to is kept in the cache.
descriptors.label: Retention: done tickets

descriptors.help: Days handover, nudge, tidy and withdrawn-suggestion timeline events are kept; the newest of each kind per session always stays.
descriptors.label: Retention: work timeline

descriptors.help: How long ended work with no live session keeps a sidebar group.
descriptors.label: Recent work

descriptors.help: Seconds between tracker sync passes. Under a minute is raised to one.
descriptors.label: Tracker sync interval

descriptors.help: How often fleet looks for hosts whose asset scan is stale, and rescans them. Under five minutes is raised to five.
descriptors.label: Asset scan check

descriptors.help: A host's assets are rescanned once its last scan is older than this, and every host after the catalog or a sync changes.
descriptors.label: Asset scan age

descriptors.help: How long a fetched ticket description is reused before the tracker is asked again; never longer than the done-tickets retention window.
descriptors.label: Ticket description cache

descriptors.help: Projects where a sole ticket key in the branch name links automatically; elsewhere it is a suggestion. Set from the work popover.
descriptors.label: Trusted branch projects

descriptors.help: Keep a short, redacted prompt snippet around a detected ticket key as evidence. Off keeps only the matched text.
descriptors.label: Keep evidence snippets

descriptors.help: Give Claude the linked ticket at session start. Makes the start hook synchronous, which can add up to 2 s when the hub is down.
descriptors.label: Ticket context at session start

descriptors.help: After three prompts with no ticket, ask Claude once which of your few open tickets it is on. Its answer is only ever a suggestion.
descriptors.label: Classification nudge

descriptors.help: The model Summarise runs on for a past session, on that session's own host and account.
descriptors.label: Summary model

descriptors.help: Days a linked ticket must be done before Tidy up suggests its session.
descriptors.label: Tidy: done for

descriptors.help: Hours a session must be idle before any tidy reason suggests it.
descriptors.label: Tidy: idle for

descriptors.help: Days a session with no work linked must sit idle and unprompted before Tidy up suggests it. Only ever suggested, never auto-tidied.
descriptors.label: Tidy: unlinked for

danger.message: The sweep will safe-kill finished sessions without asking.

descriptors.help: Let the GC sweep act on the allowed tidy reasons by itself, by safe kill or archive only. Off, Tidy up only suggests. An organisation can override it.
descriptors.label: Auto-tidy

descriptors.help: The tidy reasons auto-tidy may act on.
descriptors.label: Auto-tidy reasons

descriptors.help: Which releases the hub follows for its fleet.
descriptors.label: Release track

descriptors.help: manual: only a pinned version; notify: offer the update; automatic: install it at the next quiet point.
descriptors.label: Hub updates

descriptors.help: The same choice for fleet-agent on hosts the hub cannot reach.
descriptors.label: Agent updates

descriptors.help: The same choice for the desktop app.
descriptors.label: Desktop updates

descriptors.help: manual or notify: a phone never installs an update silently.
descriptors.label: Phone updates

descriptors.help: How often the hub re-reads the release channel, and clients check again.
descriptors.label: Update check interval

danger.message: Redacted session and ticket data will be sent to TypeSafe for organisations that opted in.

descriptors.help: The kill switch for TypeSafe's decision model. Off, nothing is ever sent. On, data goes only for organisations that opted in, redacted.
descriptors.label: Decisions (Jev)

descriptors.help: Proposing a status category for an Asana section. Shadow only records; assist suggests.
descriptors.label: Jev: status map

descriptors.help: Choosing a ticket for a session no rule could link. Shadow only records; assist suggests.
descriptors.label: Jev: work link

danger.message: Sessions and tickets outside every organisation will be sent to TypeSafe too.

descriptors.help: Also send sessions and tickets that belong to no organisation.
descriptors.label: Jev: send unassigned

descriptors.help: How long one call may take. A call is never retried.
descriptors.label: Jev: timeout

descriptors.help: Failed calls in a row that open the circuit breaker.
descriptors.label: Jev: breaker failures

descriptors.help: How long an open breaker refuses calls.
descriptors.label: Jev: breaker pause

descriptors.help: Input tokens the decision model may be sent per UTC day. At $0.042 per million, the default is under $0.09 a day.
descriptors.label: Jev: daily token budget

descriptors.help: The model version a request names. jev-1.13.0 is pinned; jev-latest follows TypeSafe.
descriptors.label: Jev: model

descriptors.help: Days a decision record (ids and numbers, never text) is kept.
descriptors.label: Jev: keep runs

descriptors.help: The address the hub daemon listens on. Loopback unless the daemon was started with a routable bind.
descriptors.label: Hub bind address

descriptors.help: The URL hosts and paired clients reach the hub at. Empty means loopback with a reverse tunnel per host.
descriptors.label: Hub public URL

descriptors.help: Extra Host header values the hub accepts, comma-separated, besides the ones its bind and public URL imply.
descriptors.label: Hub allowed hosts

descriptors.help: Whether the hub's own machine is a fleet host. On for the desktop; the daemon turns it off by default.
descriptors.label: Hub runs local sessions

descriptors.help: Whether the hub daemon may serve a routable bind without TLS.
descriptors.label: Hub serves plaintext

descriptors.help: How the hub daemon terminates TLS: off, behind a proxy, or cert, with its own certificate.
descriptors.label: Hub TLS

descriptors.help: Whether the embedded control API (MCP) runs, so an AI assistant can drive the fleet.
descriptors.label: Control API

descriptors.help: The localhost port the control API listens on.
descriptors.label: Control API port

descriptors.help: Every destructive control API call waits for a confirmation on the desktop.
descriptors.label: Confirm destructive calls

descriptors.help: Shortest time between two broadcast prompts from the same caller.
descriptors.label: Broadcast interval
